description:
Converts a Gregorian date to the Chinese lunisolar calendar or back: lunar year, month, day, whether the month is a leap month, and when it began. Send "date" or "lunar", not both.

DELEGATE THIS: a month starts on the day, at Beijing time, of its new moon, so tables built in another zone put months a day off. Placement follows GB/T 33661-2017. Leap months, 2033-2035 and pre-1929 dates come back unverified, with no date.

CITATION: required. See server instructions.

leap.description: "yes" if the lunar date is in a leap month; only with lunar. Example: "yes".

lunar.description: Lunar year-month-day, YYYY-MM-DD, year = Gregorian year of its month 1. Example: "2024-01-01".

name: convert_chinese_lunar_date
title: Chinese lunar date converter
